name: Luleč (Czechia)
description: Blue field with a white wedge issuing from the lower hoist corner to the upper fly, and a yellow fleur-de-lis in the upper hoist.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 12 January 1996 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.

features.role: wedge from the lower hoist to the upper fly
